mkdir -p programs && cat > programs/task-a6490146.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    """Fill the 3-mask from its 180-degree counterpart, then crop the mask."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 3]
    if not cells:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = grid[h - 1 - r][w - 1 - c]
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in out[r0:r1 + 1]]
PY
